title: Laredo College sets December 12 runoff for Board of Trustees Position 9
excerpt: Laredo College will hold a runoff election Saturday, December 12, for Position 9 on its Board of Trustees after no candidate won a majority in the November 3 general election. Early voting runs November 30 through December 8.
content:
Laredo College will hold a runoff election for Position 9 on the Laredo College District Board of Trustees on Saturday, December 12, 2026, after no candidate received a majority of the votes cast in the November 3 general election, the college announced.

Early voting is scheduled from Monday, November 30 through Tuesday, December 8.

Under Texas Education Code Section 130.082(g) and Laredo College Board Policy BBBB, a candidate must receive a majority of the votes cast to be declared elected. When no candidate does, the two candidates with the highest number of votes advance to a runoff, held on a Saturday designated by the secretary of state.

Laredo College President Dr. Minita Ramírez thanked the community for its strong participation in this year's election and encouraged voters to return to the polls for the runoff. Board President Esteban Rangel also encouraged voters to make their voices heard again in the runoff election.

The runoff will decide who serves Position 9 on the Board of Trustees. More information about the runoff is available on the college's elections website at go.laredo.edu/elections.

Source: Laredo College, November 9, 2026.
